2:11: The virtue of abandoning one's former life for the sake of the Lord is a prominent and recurring theme. See note on 1:14, 15.
3:1: The Apostle Peter quoted this prophecy on the Day of Pentecost (Acts 2:17–21; see Jn 20:22), when the Holy Spirit was poured out on the Christian believers, fulfilling the prophecy. Although this section forms a separate chapter, this passage should be understood as the culmination of the longer preceding prophecy. See note on 2:22–32.
4:15: Changes in the sky are a result of the war between God and his enemies. See note on 2:30, 31.
